membership: Five predeclared familiar surviving contracts, already inspected development calendar. Cross-sectional reranking within this sample is NOT a reconstructed historical exchange universe.

hypotheses.RouterOnlyV1: Rank all five markets every completed 15m candle by absolute 4h return relative to BTC plus trailing quote-volume activity; retain top three. VWAP parent when hourly ADX>=25; sweep parent when ADX<25. No forced signals.
hypotheses.RouterSMCV1: Continuation vetoes confirmed opposite hourly structure; reversals require previously confirmed swing within 0.5 ATR of prior range boundary. Prior Session3 losing structure filter is a separate control.
hypotheses.RouterICTV1: Continuation requires recent causal directional displacement FVG, correct half of prior-day range. Reversal requires raid and reclaim of prior UTC day or prior completed 8h-session boundary plus directional displacement or market structure shift. No equity kill zones.
hypotheses.RouterProfileV1: Continuation closes on favorable side of prior rolling POC and has >=1.25 net RR to nearest opposing value boundary if present. Reversal returns inside prior value with POC as first objective and >=1.25 net RR.
hypotheses.IntegratedM0V1: SMC veto for continuations, ICT prior-boundary qualification for reversals, nearest known opposing structure/profile target with >=1.25 net RR; missing orderflow is UNKNOWN, not a veto.
hypotheses.IntegratedM1V1: Identical admitted setup policy, one half exit at 1 price-risk R only if before final target and minimum size allows; cost-breakeven plus confirmed favorable swing after realized partial; tighten only. Native engine determines fills.

management.M0: initial low/high +/-0.2 ATR stop, frozen nearest known objective or 2 price-risk R fallback, completed-hour opposite thesis exit, VWAP<=8h sweep<=4h, immutable entry limit, 5m expiry
management.M1: M0 plus one 50% partial at 1R, tighten after native confirmed partial; no new positions or DCA

costs.extra_friction: turnover stress, does not refill trades

profile.availability: previous 96 completed candles; excludes signal candle
profile.trade_fidelity: genuine observed base volume at execution price; native Freqtrade footprint aggregation

orderflow.semantics: positive signed contracts = buyer taker; negative = seller taker per Gate futures WebSocket docs
orderflow.complete_requires: continuous subscribed connection covering whole interval, no reconnect, monotonic observation cutoff; late/duplicate/invalid events flagged
orderflow.confirmation: imbalance>=0.2 long or <=-0.2 short; positive directional price response for continuation, opposed prior aggression with directional rejection response for reversal
orderflow.missing_policy: UNKNOWN; strict OF variant abstains, integrated optional evidence does not fabricate confirmation
orderflow.historical_economic_impact: UNMEASURED until genuine complete data overlap actionable setups

prospective.policy: Freeze before observations; bounded owner-invoked capture+shadow only. Future economics needs native replay with aligned genuine observations. No daemon or paper activation.
